cod_assessment.drift_risk: low-medium (COD month uncertain within Q4 2026; underlying construction is real and active)
reasoning_evidence: Latest signed IA (Amendment 7, 2025-10-31) contractual Scheduled COD = 2026-12-31 — the queue's 2026-10-27 claim is ~2 months AHEAD of the generator's own most recent signed contractual date
Navco Chronicle news article independently states COD 'Winter 2026' — consistent with the IA's Dec 2026 date, not the queue's Oct 2026 date
AES.com public project page states COD 2027 (sources/aes_project_page.md) — a third, later signal, though this may be a stale/rounded marketing figure vs the more precise IA/news dates

EIA860M (plant 64349, AES Clean Energy) history (eia_history.json): planned COD was 2026-07 for reports 2025-03 through 2025-12, then MOVED LATER to 2027-05 as of the 2026-01 report — i.e. EIA's own COD estimate slipped ~10 months in the same period the ERCOT queue's COD tightened toward 2026-10-27. This divergence (EIA getting more pessimistic while the queue gets more optimistic) is decisive independent evidence the queue COD is unreliable. EIA capacity is a steady 175.0 MW throughout — a THIRD capacity figure alongside the IA's ~200 MW and the queue's 150.48 MW; EIA site coords (32.00014,-96.2027) remain ~16km off from the confirmed site and are not used for siting

Imagery shows active, advancing construction (racking-stage) as of 2026-07 with ~5-6 months to the IA's Dec 2026 target — plausible if pace holds, but Trial Operation was itself pushed from Jul-2026 (Amendment 5/6) to Jun-2026 (Amendment 7), a MINOR forward change, while In-Service slipped from Dec-2025 (Amendment 5) to Apr-2026 (Amendments 6/7) — i.e. the schedule has been getting LESS aggressive on the front end even as COD holds at Dec-2026, which is a tight buffer

6 prior COD slips over 2019-2026 (queue_history) show a long history of schedule slippage before construction began; now that dirt is moving (TCEQ storm permit + imagery) the risk profile is lower than in the paper-project years, but a further 1-2 quarter slip past Dec-2026 would not be surprising given the pattern

Independent estimate: COD lands in 2026-Q4, most likely at or near the IA's contractual 2026-12-31 date rather than the queue's optimistic 2026-10-27; AES's 2027 marketing figure and EIA's 2027-05 are treated as upper-bound risk, not central estimate, given the more specific and more recently-updated IA/news dates
